en.title: The Second-hand Bookstore's Silver Spoon and the Broken Sword Bookmark
en.premise: I work as a clerk at a cozy second-hand book cafe. One day, an elderly gentleman visits, searching for a cherished possession: a brass bookmark shaped like a sword with a broken tip. Between the discovery of a 'lost letter' during a routine cleanup and the mystery of the bookmark, a tale of hidden kindness and a long-delayed truth begins to unfold. This is a gentle story about resolving old misunderstandings and setting a frozen moment in time back into motion.

zh.title: 古本屋的银匙与折断之剑的书签
zh.premise: “我”是一名古本咖啡店的店员。某日，一位老绅士造访店内，寻找着他曾经深为珍视的、尖端折断的黄铜剑形书签。随着在整理店内时发现的一封“遗失的信件”，以及对书签之谜的追寻，隐藏在旧书中的温柔与历经岁月终于抵达的真相渐渐浮现。这是一个关于化解误会、让停滞的时间重新流动的小故事。
